description: This file defines the 'Shape' struct and associated methods to represent tensor shapes, including dimensions, size retrieval, and shape properties within TensorFlow's Go API.

classes.name: Shape
classes.description: Represents the shape of a tensor, including known and unknown dimensions, with methods to query and format the shape.

methods.name: ScalarShape
methods.description: Returns a Shape representing a scalar (zero-dimensional tensor).

methods.name: MakeShape
methods.description: Creates a Shape with specified dimensions, where -1 indicates an unknown size.

methods.name: NumDimensions
methods.description: Returns the number of dimensions of the Shape, or -1 if unknown.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns the size of a specific dimension, or -1 if unknown or invalid.

methods.name: IsFullySpecified
methods.description: Checks whether all dimensions are known.

methods.name: ToSlice
methods.description: Converts the Shape to a slice of dimensions, erroring if the number of dimensions is unknown.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the Shape, replacing unknown sizes with '?'.
